metadata.description: Personal agent skills grouped into one plugin per domain.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Software architecture and design skills: ADRs, architecture pattern advice, Domain-Driven Design (strategy and coding conventions), C4 model drafting and diagram rendering, microservices design conventions, logical component design, fitness functions, SQL schema design, and coupling/cohesion analysis (cohesion + LCOM, codebase coupling metrics, and Khononov balanced-coupling). Includes read-only coupling/cohesion analyst subagents.

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Refactoring and code-quality skills: finding where to start refactoring via git-churn hotspots, and keeping restructuring separate from behavior change.

plugins.name: ai-ml
plugins.description: AI and ML engineering skills: diagnosing and architecting LLM applications, and guiding ML projects from framing to deployment.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Planning and workflow skills: natural planning, repo status updates, and open-source contribution scouting.

plugins.name: communication
plugins.description: Communication skills: stakeholder updates, communication analysis, problem-first technical explanations, technical documentation for a named reader, and self-contained HTML artifacts.
